oak.options

Options and Option Management for the OaK framework.

This module implements temporally extended options as defined in the options framework. Each option consists of:

  • Initiation set: States where the option can start

  • Policy: Behavior while option is active

  • Termination condition: When the option completes (β(s) = 1)

Options in OaK are derived from reward-respecting GVFs and execute until their termination condition is satisfied.
